excerpt: Tamsin read it aloud. ‘Silk on silk. Always. Is that a rule or a threat?’

excerpt.text: ‘Margaret will probably ring you. She rings everybody. Just, you know. You’re allowed to say no to her. Apparently nobody does.’

caption:
